title: Tor-independent tensor comparison for a bounded projective complex
statement: Let R be a commutative ring and let A and B be R-algebras such that Tor_i^R(A,B)=0 for every i>0 [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules]. Put E=A\otimes_R B. If Q^\bullet is a bounded complex of finite projective A-modules [def-pc-perfect-complex] and D is a localization of E [lem-weil-pbc-localization-module-over-localization], then for every i the canonical map H^i(Q^\bullet\otimes_R^L B)\otimes_E D \longrightarrow H^i(Q^\bullet\otimes_A D) is an isomorphism [def-pc-derived-category, def-weil-derived-tensor].
